author: cms-sw
body:
Minimum supported micro architecture for CMSSW 20.1.X is x86-64-v2 so enable GCC to have x86-64-v2 as default so that full software stack is build with x86-64-v2 unless overridden by multi-micro architecture flag.

Note that on EL9 system GCC also use x86-64-v2 default. So this change will match EL9 system GCC. But this will also build el8 stack with x86-64-v2. This should be fine as CMSSW 20.1.X already support x86-64-v2 and above miro architectures.
title: enable x86-64-v2 for el9 and v3 for el10 and above
